message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"crash report","code":"Crash State: opt_cleanup bpf_optimize pcap_compile","note":"The report identifies the vulnerable path: pcap_compile invokes bpf_optimize, which reaches opt_cleanup during error handling and crashes with a heap double-free."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":804,"var":"optimize","code":"if (optimize && !cstate.no_optimize) { if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1) { ... } }","note":"When optimization is enabled, pcap_compile passes the intermediate filter graph into the optimizer."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1900,"var":"opt_state","code":"if (setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)) { opt_cleanup(&opt_state); return -1; }","note":"The optimizer installs an error handler that always calls opt_cleanup after any later opt_error longjmp."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_init","line":2142,"var":"opt_state->blocks","code":"opt_state->blocks = (struct block **)calloc(n, sizeof(*opt_state->blocks));","note":"opt_init allocates the block array and several other arenas for the optimizer state."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_init","line":2161,"var":"opt_state->edges","code":"if (opt_state->edges == NULL) { free(opt_state->blocks); opt_error(opt_state, \"malloc\"); }","note":"On an allocation failure, opt_init frees earlier allocations and then raises opt_error, which jumps to the setjmp handler."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_error","line":2054,"var":"longjmp(opt_state->top_ctx, 1)","code":"longjmp(opt_state->top_ctx, 1);","note":"The error path unwinds back to bpf_optimize, where opt_cleanup runs again and frees the same pointer(s) a second time, causing the heap double-free."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
